import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link to navigate to the homepage
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark").click()
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for the page to load
    
    # Find the 'Recent Posts' section using accessibility roles
    # Try as a region first
    recent_posts_section = page.get_by_role("region", name="Recent Posts", exact=False)
    if await recent_posts_section.count() == 0:
        # If not found as region, try as a list
        recent_posts_section = page.get_by_role("list", name="Recent Posts", exact=False)
    if await recent_posts_section.count() == 0:
        # If still not found, raise an exception
        raise Exception("Could not find 'Recent Posts' section on the page after navigation.")
    
    # Within the section, find all links that represent recent posts
    links = recent_posts_section.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await links.count()
    if link_count >= 2:
        # Click the second most recent link (index 1)
        await links.nth(1).click()
        await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for navigation or load after click
    else:
        # If not enough links, raise an exception
        raise Exception(f"Found only {link_count} link(s) in 'Recent Posts' section, need at least 2.")
